mainEntity.name: Is starting an AI newsletter a realistic first business, and what could AI automate for me?

acceptedAnswer.text:
A newsletter can be a practical first project because AI can assist with topic research, issue outlines, drafting, repurposing, subscriber ideas, and sponsor research. The owner still needs a clear audience, editorial standard, reliable sources, and a consistent publishing decision.

Context: Run My AI Biz is the business’s weekly Substack newsletter, with a free starting option and a paid subscription listed at $9 per month for full weekly issues. Its content focuses on sourced AI tool comparisons, pricing explanations, development context, and practical examples.

Key factors:
- Narrow audience and recurring need
- Source quality and fact checking
- Sustainable publishing frequency
- Free-to-paid value distinction

Practical guidance: Choose a repeatable issue format and create a research-to-draft checklist. Review sources, tool prices, and claims before publication, then track readership and subscriber response to refine topics.

The newsletter itself demonstrates an educational route for learning before building more complex automation.
acceptedAnswer.description: An AI newsletter can be a manageable first project if it serves a specific audience and recurring information need. AI can assist with research, outlines, drafts, repurposing, and sponsor research, while you verify sources, review claims, choose topics, and maintain the publication standard.
